question: Does the claim that a god comes and acts fit the true nature of reality?
premises: The report that a god comes and acts may suit scriptural statements.
The ultimate nature is formless and beyond such limitations.
A doctrine must fit that ultimate nature to be fully valid.
inference: The coming-and-going account is only scripturally suitable, while the formless nature is what truly fits.
plain_english: Saying 'O god, he comes' is fitting only within scriptural statements; but all this is truly fitting only as the nature of the formless and so forth.
